name: image_adapthisteq
setup: [X, Y] = meshgrid(linspace(0, 1, 64), linspace(0, 1, 64)); I = uint8(255 * sqrt(X.*Y));
comment: MATLAB Image Toolbox adapthisteq — CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalisation). Faithful port of MATLAB R2025b adapthisteq.m. Five algorithmic details that produce bit-exact agreement: (1) symmetric pad to dims divisible by NumTiles with even tile dims; (2) per-tile clip with clipLimit = ceil(N/NBins) + round(normCL·(N - minCL)) and the two-pass redistribute (upperLimit pass + step-size remainder loop); (3) mapping m[k] = min(Lo + cumsum[k]·valSpread/N, Hi)/fullRange; (4) (NumTiles+1)² interpolation tiles with half-tile borders + integer-weight bilinear (rowRevW/colRevW); (5) ROUND-THEN-BILINEAR: each of the 4 LUT lookups is quantised to the output class BEFORE the weighted sum (matches MATLAB's `double(grayxform(imgPixVals, mapTile))` semantics). The last detail is what closes the final off-by-1 on uint8 rounding boundaries. Defaults: NumTiles=[8 8], ClipLimit=0.01, NBins=256, Distribution='uniform'. Bit-exact MATLAB R2025b (tol=0 on all 11 probed fingerprints). KNOWN GAPS: 'rayleigh' / 'exponential' distributions throw (deferred). Octave 11.1.0 indexes adapthisteq in image package but doesn't ship — harness reports N/A there.
